_comment: Required standards references per repo type. Intentionally empty: the required_refs check only emits errors (no warn tier), and a 2026-04-24 audit found zero tool repos linking standards/*.md, so any requirement here would fail every weekly drift run at once. Populate per repo type once tool repos reference standards deliberately, starting with one link (for example AGENTS.md -> standards/agents-template.md) rolled out across the fleet first. Revisited in DTD#125.
